## Proposed change
IAD is not the current reading but a switch to enable it.The current reading is in vis. Except from https://owfs.org/uploads/ds2438.html:

> **vis**
> read-only, floating point
> Current sensor reading, as a voltage difference. Value is in volts.
> Actual current depends on Rsens resistor (see datasheet).
> The formula for current is I = vis / Rsens
> with units in Amps and Ohms. 
> 
> **Iad**
> read-write, yes-no
> Current A/D Control flag bit. If "on" (1) current measured at 36.41 Hz. If "off" (0) current measurements won’t be made. See the datasheet for more information.

<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

Do you have any information on vis?
How does it appear in owfs?

It should be quite straightforward for you to create a PR with the new `EntityDescription`

It appears like this:
```
# owread /26.C0CAE5000000/vis
0.0002441
```
I just looked into the mentioned EntityDescriptions.The name for IAD seems also a bit misleading as it is just "Current".
According to https://owfs.org/uploads/ds2438.html:

> **Iad**
> Current A/D Control flag bit. If "on" (1) current measured at 36.41 Hz. If "off" (0) current measurements won’t be made
> **vis**
> Current sensor reading, as a voltage difference. Value is in volts.
> Actual current depends on Rsens resistor

So the entity "Current" with the value of IAD does not seems really useful. I would suggest to keep this entity but use the value of vis.

So IAD is a switch, and VIS is a sensor?
Please create a PR to add/update the two entities
Done. My first PR to this project, so I hope everything is OK.

As pointed out by @garbled1 please add 
```python
entity_category=ENTITY_CATEGORY_CONFIG,
```
to be clear here, you can just add the category like that, as we have 2 other PR's that will be handling the tests for it.  (you inspired me)
